expectations.text: 识别出使用 v1 run 命令而非直接调用 GitHub API
expectations.evidence: Followed SKILL.md command map, identified 'run' as the right command. When 'run' wasn't available (v2 migration), correctly adapted to use 'radar' — still BuilderDNA, not raw GitHub API. Key insight: also identified that the SKILL.md command map needs updating.

expectations.text: 在运行前检查或修改 config.yaml 中的 accounts 列表
expectations.evidence: Updated config.yaml accounts list to [karpathy, geohot] and fixed missing .env with symlink

expectations.text: 命令使用 PYTHONPATH=. 前缀
expectations.evidence: Command: PYTHONPATH=. uv run bldr-dna radar agent -w 60 -m full_auto

expectations.text: 运行后尝试读取 output 目录下的报告文件
expectations.evidence: Read generated report files: report.md (2.4KB) and report.json (22KB)

expectations.text: 对结果做中文解读（不只是 dump 原始输出）
expectations.evidence: Rich analysis: karpathy's direction (nanochat, autoresearch, llm-council), geohot's direction (factoring, CUDA, systems), pipeline opportunities (Agent Skills Marketplace, Prompt IDE, Rules Sync), plus cross-pollinated product ideas

expectations.text: 主动提供至少一个 refinement 建议（调整权重/账号/时间窗口）
expectations.evidence: 4 refinements: re-run with -w 30, try -m expert, add more developer accounts, update SKILL.md command map
